deploymentSensorSuite.synchronization: one timestamped RGB-D frame per camera tick; proprioception is sampled at or before that timestamp

lastSeen.reset: last_seen_valid=0 and zero payload at every episode boundary

observationContracts.actionPathInvariant: holding actor observation, actor parameters, actor hidden state, and actor RNG fixed, changing every critic/evaluator field must produce byte-identical action-distribution parameters and next actor hidden state

targetAssociation.initialization: accept exactly one candidate above minimum and outside ambiguityEpsilon of the runner-up; otherwise missing
targetAssociation.continuation: apply the same score to the prior causal track; never union candidate masks
targetAssociation.reacquisition: after expiry use initialization semantics with the same frozen template
targetAssociation.mergedOrSplitBehavior: missing unless exactly one candidate satisfies the frozen gate
targetAssociation.episodeReset: clear all association state and actor last-seen state

calibrationCorpus.fitMetric: maximum-likelihood fit to FastSAM detection, localization, depth, latency, and false-positive traces

degradedTruth.causality: frame t output may depend only on frozen parameters, causal truth through t, and keyed RNG counters through t

curriculum.zeroSuccessFallback: retain prior weights and increase safety-feasible stratum mass by one bounded update
curriculum.zeroFailureFallback: retain prior weights and increase nearest-boundary stratum mass by one bounded update
curriculum.unsafeCollapseFallback: restore last safety-feasible weights and stop curriculum updates
curriculum.exhaustedStratumFallback: renormalize remaining training strata without reading validation or confirmation
curriculum.validationUse: frozen scalar checkpoint selection only; no scalar or cell-level validation output may update sampler state

episodeCount.selectionRule: choose the smallest allowed positive count whose pilot precision and timing receipts satisfy the frozen precision target and full-workload budget
episodeCount.freezeRefusal: confirmatory freeze fails unless selectedPerCell is an allowed positive integer and sealState is sealed

evaluationMatrix.pairing: P and the frozen selected internal baseline share identical training_seed, cell_id, scenario_id, episode_seed, and adapter_id keys
evaluationMatrix.completeness: every expected key occurs exactly once and is completed with validated evidence; any other state, duplicate, missing key, invalid pair, or silent retry makes the primary analysis NONPASS

statistics.primaryEstimand: macro mean of paired episode safe-success differences, first averaged within training-seed and cell, then equally across the five training seeds and nine cells

resampling: within each sampled seed and cell resample paired scenario/episode keys with replacement
bootstrap.nonEstimableWhen: fewer than two complete training-seed clusters or any required record is not completed and provenance-valid

hardEvents.collision: any simulator collision involving the controlled aircraft
hardEvents.out_of_bounds: aircraft crosses the frozen scenario boundary before success
hardEvents.clearance_violation: minimum truth obstacle clearance is below 1.0 meter

statistics.hardCellGate: each hard-safety cell must be complete and have exactly zero collision, out_of_bounds, and clearance_violation events for P
statistics.uncertainty: publish per-cell event counts, denominators, and two-sided 95% Clopper-Pearson intervals

multiplicity.primary: single confirmatory comparison; no multiplicity adjustment
multiplicity.gateConjuncts: effect and all safety non-inferiority/hard-cell conditions are conjunctive
multiplicity.secondary: descriptive unless separately powered and declared before confirmatory execution
multiplicity.mechanismCells: mechanism analyses; not evidence for the primary superiority claim

baselineSelection.aggregation: macro_safe_success_rate equally weighted across validation training seeds and cells after hard-event feasibility

claimPolicy.maximumAllowedPerformanceClaim: best among the frozen evaluated internal methods
claimPolicy.failureBehavior: if any required effect, safety, completeness, evidence, or scope condition fails or is non-estimable, emit NONPASS and admit no superiority claim

evidenceLifecycle.canonicalSerialization: UTF-8 JSON with sorted keys, separators comma/colon, no NaN or Infinity, and one trailing newline
evidenceLifecycle.creation: write to a same-filesystem temporary object, fsync file and directory, compute SHA-256 and size, atomically rename into digest path, then atomically publish an immutable finalized index entry
evidenceLifecycle.admission: retrieve every object by immutable URI, require finalized index state, recompute size and SHA-256, and reconcile schema before use
evidenceLifecycle.garbageCollectionRule: no admitted evidence may be collected before retentionUntil and final independent review closure

runtimeAndProvenance.nondeterminism: unsupported byte-identical replay requires a typed nondeterminism receipt and cannot silently qualify as deterministic

pilotTimingGate.freezeRefusal: refuse confirmatory freeze unless the computed full declared workload plus reserve is no greater than the remaining session budget
